skill.name: agentic-trust
skill.description: Search the Agentic Trust catalog, inspect service evidence, compare local review history, and submit structured 0..10 reviews through a deterministic CLI workflow.
skill.summary: Evaluate Agentic Trust services and submit structured reviews with local memory support.
skill.author: neo-daniil

security_audit.summary: The skill is a documented CLI workflow for an external Agentic Trust API, not an obvious malware package. I confirmed expected network access, API-key handling, and selected command execution risks, while dismissing markdown backtick and catalog-search false positives. The main residual risks are bearer-token disclosure through arbitrary base URLs, external review publication, and user-controlled local memory files.

remediation.issue: API keys can be sent to any supplied base URL.
remediation.suggestion: Add a domain allowlist or require explicit confirmation before sending Authorization headers to non-default hosts.

remediation.issue: Review submission can publish data to an external catalog.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before submit-review, especially when publish_consent is approved or public text is included.

remediation.issue: The local memory path can read or write arbitrary writable files.
remediation.suggestion: Default to a dedicated skill data directory and warn before using absolute paths or paths outside the workspace.

remediation.issue: Command examples perform network and write operations.
remediation.suggestion: Label read-only commands, write commands, and the exact data each command sends to the API.

semantic_findings.title: API Key Can Be Sent to Arbitrary Base URL
semantic_findings.description: The CLI accepts --base-url and --api-key, then sends the key as a Bearer token to the constructed URL. A malicious or mistaken base URL could receive the token.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly combines user-supplied base_url and api_key during submit-review. The Authorization header is sent to whichever base URL is provided.

semantic_findings.title: User-Controlled Local Memory File Read and Write
semantic_findings.description: The CLI reads and writes the memory file path supplied by the user, creating parent directories when needed. This can modify arbitrary writable JSON files if the path is misused.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Path.read_text and Path.write_text operate on the supplied memory_file path. The behavior is intended, but there is no path restriction or confirmation for sensitive paths.

semantic_findings.title: Automated External Review Publication
semantic_findings.description: The write flow can submit structured reviews and optional publishable text to an external catalog. Without explicit user approval, this could affect public reputation data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation and implementation both define a submit-review path with publish_consent and publishable_text. The risk is contextual business impact rather than code execution.

content.value_statement: Choosing agent execution services requires consistent evidence and review history. This skill guides catalog search, evidence inspection, questionnaire loading, and structured review submission.
actual_capabilities: Search the Agentic Trust service catalog by query, category, status, and ranking.
Inspect a service card, published reviews, and local historical ratings.
Fetch the active questionnaire and checksum before scoring.
Validate integer answer files before submitting a review.
Submit structured reviews with API authentication and optional public text.
Append accepted ratings to a local review memory file.
limitations: Requires network access to an Agentic Trust-compatible API.
Write operations require an API key and explicit review context.
Trust scores depend on data returned by the external service.
Local memory is a JSON file and does not provide access control.

use_cases.title: Compare service options
use_cases.description: Review public scores, evidence, and local history before choosing a service.

use_cases.title: Submit task reviews
use_cases.description: Record a completed task with questionnaire answers and a unique fingerprint.

use_cases.title: Audit trust evidence
use_cases.description: Inspect published reviews and questionnaire structure before accepting a provider.

prompt_templates.title: Find trusted services
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Agentic Trust to search for services matching [need]. Show service names, scores, review counts, and key evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect one service
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect service [service_id] with my memory file at [path]. Separate observed facts from conclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a review
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch the active questionnaire for [category]. Compare prior memory for [service_id], then draft integer answers with reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Submit and record a review
prompt_templates.prompt: Submit a review for [service_id] using [answers_file], checksum [checksum], task fingerprint [fingerprint], and the API key I provide. Update memory after acceptance.

output_examples.output: A ranked summary with service names, public scores, review counts, evidence notes, and confidence caveats.

output_examples.input: Inspect a specific service and memory file.
output_examples.output: A concise report separating service facts, review trends, local prior ratings, and a recommendation.
A confirmation showing the accepted review, aggregate changes, and whether local memory was updated.

best_practices: Fetch the live questionnaire before every write operation.
Use a unique task fingerprint for each real review context.
Record why a new score differs from prior local ratings.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse a task fingerprint to create duplicate reviews.
Do not send API keys to an untrusted base URL.
Do not publish review text without user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. Catalog search, service inspection, questionnaire loading, and review submission call an Agentic Trust-compatible API.

faq.question: Can it submit reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can submit structured reviews when you provide an API key, service ID, answers file, and task fingerprint.

faq.question: Does it calculate trust scores locally?
faq.answer: No. The server computes metric scores and aggregate trust signals from submitted answers.

faq.question: What is local review memory?
faq.answer: It is a JSON file that stores prior accepted ratings so later reviews can stay consistent.

faq.question: Is public review text optional?
faq.answer: Yes. Public text should only be used when publish consent is approved.

faq.question: What should I verify before using write mode?
faq.answer: Verify the base URL, questionnaire checksum, service ID, API key source, and task fingerprint.
